description: Workspace connection credentials are polymorphic on `authType`; the converted model keeps only the base members, so S.Struct strips `credentials` on encode (create/update) and decode (listSecrets). Add it as a document on the input and output property shapes.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Credentials for the authType (ApiKey: {key}; CustomKeys: {keys}; AccessKey: {accessKeyId, secretAccessKey}; ...).
Credentials for the authType; only returned by listSecrets.
